title: Piers Park Sailing Center
specs: Inclusive and accessible sailing programs with ADA-accessible facilities
Over 3,000 children participate annually in youth programs
Located on the East Boston waterfront with views of Boston Harbor and skyline
Guests must be at least 4 years old to sail or kayak
Participants in Learn to Sail must be adults over 21 years old
Swim certification required for youth programs; must swim 50 yards and tread water 5 minutes for adults
All participants must sign guest release form; minors require guardian signature
Passholders must have valid sail or kayak pass to use boats
Groups from 2 to 42 participants; larger groups split across multiple boats
Group sailing boats hold 4-6 people plus a qualified skipper
includes: Life jackets and all sailing equipment provided
Qualified skipper on board for group sailing
gap: Exact duration and schedule details for group sailing sessions not stated
blurb: Piers Park Sailing Center offers sailing and kayaking experiences, youth programs, and group sailing activities. They provide sailing lessons for beginners and opportunities for independent sailing with a valid pass. The center emphasizes safety, inclusivity, and environmental stewardship.
extraNote: Boats available by online reservation only · Boats must return 30 minutes before sunset or incur $50 late fee per 15 minutes · No alcohol or drugs allowed on boats or premises; violation results in termination of privileges · Smoking and vaping prohibited on dock, boats, and office · Cancellation and fee adjustments possible due to weather or operational disruptions · Damage fees up to $500 deductible plus full cost for uninsured damage; towing fees $100-$500 depending on boundary · Piers Park dock, East Boston waterfront · May 1st to October 31st regular season; November 1st to April 30th hardy season
